narrative.headline: Top 50 tape is strongly risk-on with 28 BULLISH names led by financials, energy, and select mega-cap tech, while AAPL and semis-cap names (AMAT, CSCO, KLAC) show institutional distribution.

XOM: 10.0 across the board — $436M dark pool stacked behind near-money call flow, energy bid confirmed by CVX (10.0, $544M DP)
NVDA: 9.41 score — $56M call premium dwarfs everything in the tape, amplified by $1.32B dark pool print
C: 9.75 with $2.88M call premium + $385M DP — banks broadly accumulated alongside JPM and MS (9.84)
INTC: 9.52 — $31M call premium + $757M dark pool is the strongest semi positioning by far
GOOG: 9.29 — $17M call premium + $461M DP, mega-cap tech leadership narrowing to GOOG/NVDA/NFLX
TXN: 9.68 — $2.46M call premium + $522M DP stands out as the lone bullish semi in a weak chip tape
bearish_setups: AAPL: 1.64 score, flow only 2.73 — put-skewed premium despite $10 DP/blocks signals heavy institutional distribution
AMAT: 2.06, flow 3.44 — semi-cap equipment being unwound, confirmed by CSCO (1.96) and KLAC (0.13)
WMT: 0.43 with flow at 0.0 — consumer staples bid is selective (PEP bullish, WMT not)
BAC: 0.07 — sharp divergence from JPM/C/MS bullish bank trade, idiosyncratic distribution
GE: 1.38, flow 2.29 — industrial leader being faded
MRK: 0.33 with flow 0.0 — pharma split, ABBV bullish while MRK is sold
narrative.rotation_signal: Clear rotation INTO financials (JPM/C/MS/V), energy (XOM/CVX), and select mega-cap tech (NVDA/GOOG/NFLX/INTC/TXN), and OUT OF semi-cap equipment (AMAT/KLAC/CSCO), AAPL, and consumer/industrial laggards (WMT/HD/GE). The bullish breadth (28 names) signals broad institutional risk-on, but the AAPL + semi-equipment weakness suggests rotation within tech rather than wholesale chase.
narrative.diverging_from_industry_layer: AAPL bearish read diverges from any broad mega-cap tech bullishness — institutions are picking NVDA/GOOG/INTC over AAPL. Semi-cap equipment (AMAT/KLAC) bearish while NVDA/INTC/TXN bullish is an unusual intra-semi split worth flagging against any uniformly bullish semis industry call.
